title.zh: 单位圆 · 正弦 · 正切

desc.zh: 圆、正弦、正切是同一个运动的三种测量。切换视角，看它们如何互为投影。
desc.en: Circle, sine and tangent are three measurements of one motion. Switch views to see each as a projection of the others.

tag.zh: 圆 · sin · tan

title.en: The Essence of the Fourier Transform

desc.zh: 把信号绕在圆上缠绕，当缠绕频率对上信号频率，重心便偏移——频谱由此显形。
desc.en: Wind a signal around a circle — when the winding frequency matches the signal's own, the center of mass shifts, and the spectrum reveals itself.

tag.zh: 缠绕 · 频谱

desc.zh: 两个复数相乘，幅角相加、模长相乘——旋转叠着伸缩。切到复平面正视，两段角度叠起来正好落在乘积上。
desc.en: Multiply two complex numbers and their angles add while their lengths multiply — rotation stacked on scaling. Switch to the face-on complex-plane view and the two angles stack up exactly onto the product.

tag.zh: 旋转 · 伸缩

changelog.zh: 新增棣莫弗定理、n 次方根与复数轨迹页签
changelog.en: Added De Moivre, nth-roots and complex-loci tabs

desc.zh: 直角坐标与极坐标是同一个平面的两套语言：同一个点用 (x, y) 或 (r, θ) 描述，同一个函数换个读法就变成螺线或玫瑰线。
desc.en: Cartesian and polar are two languages for the same plane: the same point is (x, y) or (r, θ), and the same function reads as a spiral or a rose depending on how you look at it.

tag.zh: 坐标 · 变换

changelog.zh: 新增雅可比页签：dA = r·dr·dθ 的局部面积缩放
changelog.en: Added Jacobian tab: local area scaling dA = r·dr·dθ

desc.zh: 椭圆、抛物线、双曲线曾被当作三种曲线，其实是同一把刀切同一个圆锥，姿态连续变化的结果——离心率 e 把它们统一成一条曲线。
desc.en: Ellipse, parabola and hyperbola look like three different curves, but they're really one blade slicing one cone at continuously changing angles — eccentricity e unifies them into a single curve.

tag.zh: 椭圆 · 抛物线 · 双曲线

desc.zh: 期望值骗人，复利不骗人：长期增长率是一座有峰的山，峰顶 f* = p − q/b 就是凯利公式。四种策略同赌一串硬币，看谁真正跑得快。
desc.en: Expected value lies; compounding doesn't. Long-run growth is a mountain whose peak, f* = p − q/b, is the Kelly criterion. Four strategies bet the same coin flips — watch who actually wins.

tag.zh: 增长 · 下注

desc.zh: 微分学 = 以直代曲：割线吸附成切线（导数）、增量拆成 dy + o(Δx)（微分）、两根切线撑起切平面（偏微分与全微分）。一维的直是线，二维的直是面，误差永远是高阶无穷小。
desc.en: Differential calculus = replace curved with flat: secants snap into tangents (the derivative), increments split into dy + o(Δx) (the differential), and two tangents span the tangent plane (partials and the total differential).

tag.zh: 切线 · 微分 · 切平面

changelog.zh: 新增链式法则页签：两次局部缩放的连乘
changelog.en: Added chain-rule tab: two local scalings composed

desc.zh: 整本公式手册只有一台机器——单位圆上的旋转：和角公式是「转过 α 再转 β」，诱导公式是镜子与旋转，辅助角是向量合成。每页附上它生成的公式清单，记一张圆等于记一本书。
desc.en: The whole identity handbook is one machine — rotation on the unit circle: angle sums are 'rotate α then β', reduction formulas are mirrors and turns, the auxiliary angle is vector addition. Each tab lists the formulas it generates — memorize one circle, own the book.

tag.zh: 和角 · 诱导 · 辅助角

desc.zh: t = tan(x/2) 不是凭空的技巧，是从 (−1,0) 引弦的斜率：圆周角定理给出半角，弦斜率有理则落点必有理——sin、cos 全部化成 t 的有理式，三角积分变成有理函数积分，勾股数也从这根弦上一个个滑出来。
desc.en: t = tan(x/2) is no trick out of thin air — it's the slope of the chord from (−1,0): the inscribed angle theorem yields the half angle, and a rational slope forces a rational point, so sin and cos turn rational in t, trig integrals become rational-function integrals, and Pythagorean triples slide right off the chord.

tag.zh: 弦斜率 · 有理化 · 勾股数

desc.zh: 反三角是「从值取回角」的机器：横线打穿圆不止一次，必须切一段单调主枝——图象是 y=x 的镜像、导数互为倒数；而 arcsin(sin θ) 折成三角波、arctan(tan θ) 折成锯齿，就是「折回主值带」在时间轴上的显形。
desc.en: Inverse trig retrieves the angle from a value: the line pierces the circle more than once, so a monotone branch must be cut — the graph mirrors over y=x with reciprocal slopes, and arcsin(sin θ) folding into a triangle wave (arctan into a sawtooth) is that principal-band folding made visible in time.

tag.zh: 主值 · 镜像 · 折叠

desc.zh: 分析学只有两件工具：标度变换看局部，比值看快慢——而「阶」决定生死。高阶无穷小塌成地毯、差一阶的级数生死两分、显微镜下可导变直线、尖角永远是尖角、裂谷冲出画面。
desc.en: Analysis has just two tools: rescaling to see the local, ratios to see who's faster — and order decides everything. Higher-order infinitesimals collapse flat, series one order apart live or die, and under the microscope smooth curves straighten, kinks stay kinks, and jumps tear open.

tag.zh: 阶 · 收敛 · 可导

desc.zh: DFT 不是近似，是换坐标：N 个采样在频谱走廊里排成 N/2 个格子，逆变换一比特不丢地拼回来——连噪声都原样还原；而滤波，只是在另一套坐标里扔掉几个格子。
desc.en: The DFT is not an approximation — it's a change of coordinates: N samples become N/2 bins in a spectrum corridor, and the inverse rebuilds them bit-for-bit, noise included; filtering is just dropping a few bins in the other coordinate system.

tag.zh: 频谱 · 重建 · 滤波

desc.zh: 同一对向量 u、v，三种读法：平行四边形加法与点乘投影；叉乘立起来是「带方向的面积」；竖起来当矩阵的列，就是把空间变形的指令——行列式正是那块面积。
desc.en: One pair of vectors, three readings: parallelogram addition and dot-product shadows; the cross product standing up as signed area; stood up as matrix columns they warp space itself — and the determinant is that very area.

tag.zh: 向量 · 矩阵 · 行列式

changelog.zh: 新增特征向量页签：不转弯的方向
changelog.en: Added eigenvectors tab: directions that never turn

desc.zh: 钟形曲线不是被选出来的，是被「叠加」逼出来的：n 个随机数相加，方块两步变三角、几步成钟形（中心极限定理）；σ 就藏在拐点里，68-95-99.7 锁在 σ 的倍数里。
desc.en: The bell curve isn't chosen — it's forced by addition: sum a few random numbers and a block becomes a triangle, then a bell (the CLT); σ hides at the inflection point, and 68-95-99.7 lock to its multiples.

tag.zh: 钟形 · 中心极限

changelog.zh: 新增二维联合分布页签：ρ 决定概率云的方向，边缘分布是压扁后的影子
changelog.en: Added 2D joint-distribution tab: ρ tilts the probability cloud, marginals are its squashed shadows

title.zh: 微积分的本质 · 从一重到三重
title.en: The Essence of Calculus · Single to Triple

desc.zh: 积分是「切片 → 求值 → 堆叠」的升维游戏：面积曲线的斜率就是原函数（基本定理）；二重是一重的一重，三重是二重的一重——同一次扫描，三种维度。
desc.en: Integration is slice → evaluate → stack, one dimension at a time: the area curve's slope is the original function (FTC); a double integral is an integral of integrals, a triple one more — one sweep, three dimensions.

tag.zh: 面积 · 体积 · 质量

changelog.zh: 新增旋转体页签：圆盘 πf²dx 与圆柱壳 2πxf dx
changelog.en: Added volume-of-revolution tab: disks πf²dx vs shells 2πxf dx

desc.zh: 多项式是函数的局部拥抱：每加一阶就多抱住一段。但抱不过收敛半径——ln(1+x) 在 x=3 明明光滑，级数却死在琥珀墙前，因为半径由最近的奇点决定。
desc.en: A Taylor polynomial hugs its function locally — each order hugs a little further, but never past the radius of convergence: ln(1+x) is smooth at x=3, yet the series dies at an amber wall set by the nearest singularity.

tag.zh: 逼近 · 收敛

title.en: Parametric Curves as Shadows of Motion

desc.zh: 参数方程不是两条函数，而是一个运动点的两组坐标记录：把轨迹提升进 (x, y, t) 空间，两道影子就是分量函数——正对时间轴看去，空间曲线塌回轨迹本身。
desc.en: A parametric curve is not two functions but one moving point's two coordinate logs: lift the motion into (x, y, t) space and its two shadows are the component graphs — look down the time axis and the space curve collapses back into the trace.

tag.zh: 摆线 · 利萨如 · 速度

title.zh: 三维直线与平面的本质

desc.zh: 三维解析几何就是用方向向量 d 与法向量 n 划定自由度与约束：沿 d 望去直线塌成一点，正对 n 平面铺满视野，沿公垂线看异面直线「相交」却永不相遇。
desc.en: 3D analytic geometry pins freedom and constraint with direction d and normal n: look down d and the line collapses to a point, face n and the plane fills the view, sight down the common perpendicular and skew lines 'cross' yet never meet.

tag.zh: 直线 · 平面 · 异面

desc.zh: 双曲函数是单位双曲线的自然坐标，正如 sin、cos 是单位圆的自然坐标：参数 u 不是角度而是扇形面积的两倍，cosh 与 sinh 是 eᵘ/2 与 e⁻ᵘ/2 的和与差——而悬链线并不是抛物线。
desc.en: Hyperbolic functions are the unit hyperbola's natural coordinates, as sin and cos are the circle's: u is not an angle but twice the sector area, cosh and sinh are the sum and difference of eᵘ/2 and e⁻ᵘ/2 — and a hanging chain is not a parabola.

tag.zh: 双曲线 · 扇形面积 · 悬链线

desc.zh: 微分方程不是寻找神秘公式，而是在局部方向规则中寻找完整轨迹：解曲线处处与方向场相切，函数图、变化率与相图只是同一条 (t, y, y′) 轨迹在三面墙上的影子——阻尼比 ζ 决定相平面里是闭合椭圆还是向内螺旋。
desc.en: A differential equation isn't a hunt for a secret formula — it's a whole trajectory hiding in a local direction rule: solutions stay tangent to the field, and the graph, rate and phase portrait are three shadows of one (t, y, y′) curve; damping ζ decides between closed orbits and inward spirals.

tag.zh: 方向场 · 相图 · 阻尼

title.zh: 曲面、等高线、梯度和切平面

desc.zh: 等高线是曲面被水平面切出的截口，梯度则是垂直穿过这些等高线、上升最快的方向：俯视时三维山丘塌成等高线地图，∇f 的箭头根根垂直于等高线——切平面是曲面在一点的线性替身。
desc.en: Contours are the surface's horizontal slices; the gradient cuts perpendicularly through them, climbing fastest. Look straight down and the 3D hill collapses into a contour map with ∇f arrows crossing every contour at right angles — and the tangent plane is the surface's local linear stand-in.

tag.zh: 等高线 · 梯度 · 切平面

title.zh: 运动学：一个运动，多张图像

desc.zh: 抛体不是一种复杂运动，而是水平匀速与竖直匀加速共享同一个时间参数：三维曲线 (x, y, t) 的三个投影就是 x–t 直线、y–t 抛物线与真实轨迹——而 v–t 图下的面积永远等于位移。
desc.en: A projectile is not one complex motion but uniform horizontal + uniformly-accelerated vertical sharing one clock: the (x, y, t) curve projects into a straight x–t line, a y–t parabola and the true path — and the area under v–t always equals the displacement.

tag.zh: 位移 · 速度 · 抛体

desc.zh: 递推关系不是直接给出数列，而是定义一台反复把输出送回输入的机器：蛛网图里楼梯收敛、螺旋交替、越界发散，|f′| 定生死；牛顿迭代不过是同一台机器装上了切线。
desc.en: A recurrence doesn't hand you the sequence — it defines a machine feeding output back into input: cobweb staircases converge, spirals alternate, escapes diverge, and |f′| decides which; Newton–Raphson is the same machine fitted with tangent lines.

tag.zh: 蛛网图 · 不动点 · 牛顿法

desc.zh: 系统的运动不是任意的，而是沿着能量允许的几何轨道行进：相图轨道就是能量曲面 E = ½mv² + V(x) 的水平等高线——小球在势阱里往返于两个转折点之间，分界线把束缚与逃逸一分为二。
desc.en: Motion is not arbitrary — it rides the orbits energy permits: phase-portrait orbits are level sets of the energy surface E = ½mv² + V(x). The ball shuttles between turning points in its well, and the separatrix splits bound from escaping motion.

tag.zh: 势阱 · 等能线 · 分界线

desc.zh: e 不是神秘常数，而是几条完全不同的路交汇的点：复利拆到无穷是它，导数等于自己是它，1/x 下面积恰好为 1 还是它；统计里的 37% 是它反着转，利息付在虚数方向，它就绕成了圆——e^iπ + 1 = 0。
desc.en: e is not a mystic constant but the meeting point of unrelated roads: infinite compounding lands on it, the self-derivative singles it out, unit area under 1/x pins it again; statistics' 37% is the same machine in reverse, and paying the interest at 90° bends growth into a circle — e^iπ + 1 = 0.

tag.zh: 复利 · 自我导数 · e^iπ

changelog.zh: 首发：复利极限 / 自我导数 / 随自己生长 / 面积为 1 / 统计里的 e / 欧拉公式 六场景
changelog.en: Initial release: compound limit / self-derivative / growing at its own height / unit area / e in statistics / Euler's formula

desc.zh: π 不是圆的装饰品，而是「转一圈」留下的签名：轮子滚半圈铺平就是它，阿基米德的多边形从两侧夹住它，披萨拼图立起来是 πr²，不认识圆的撒点投票选出它，振荡的级数一步步咬住它。
desc.en: π is not the circle's ornament — it's the signature of one full turn: a half-roll laid flat measures it, Archimedes' polygons pinch it from both sides, the pizza jigsaw stands up as πr², dots that know nothing of circles vote for it, and an oscillating series bites down on it.

tag.zh: 滚轮 · 夹逼 · 撒点

changelog.zh: 首发：展开一圈 / 阿基米德夹逼 / 圆面积拼图 / 概率里的 π / 级数与 π 五场景
changelog.en: Initial release: unrolling / Archimedes' squeeze / area jigsaw / π in probability / series reaching π

desc.zh: φ 不是「最美的比例」，而是自相似的唯一解：切掉正方形剩下的还是黄金矩形，斐波那契比值从两侧咬住它，全是 1 的连分数让它成为最难逼近的数——而这正是向日葵选中 137.5° 的原因。
desc.en: φ is not "the most beautiful ratio" — it is the unique fixed point of self-similarity: remove a square and the golden rectangle remains, Fibonacci ratios bite it from both sides, the all-1s continued fraction makes it the hardest number to approximate — which is exactly why the sunflower chose 137.5°.

tag.zh: 自相似 · 斐波那契 · 向日葵

changelog.zh: 首发：黄金分割 / 斐波那契拼图 / 最无理的数 / 向日葵叶序 / 五角星 五场景
changelog.en: Initial release: the golden cut / Fibonacci tiling / the most irrational number / sunflower phyllotaxis / pentagram

desc.zh: i 不是「想象出来的数」，而是旋转 90° 的名字：i² = −1 只是说两次直角转弯等于掉头。它靠给三次方程当桥闯进数学，把丢失的根藏在纸面外，与镜像孪生 −i 同行让实数世界滴水不漏——最后露出真身：一个实实在在的旋转矩阵。
desc.en: i is not an "imaginary" number — it is the name of the quarter turn: i² = −1 just says two right-angle turns make a U-turn. It broke into mathematics as the cubic formula's unavoidable bridge, hides the missing roots off the paper, travels with its mirror twin −i so the real world never leaks — and finally turns out to be nothing but a rotation matrix.

tag.zh: 旋转 · 卡尔达诺 · 矩阵

changelog.zh: 首发：转四分之一圈 / 从三次方程闯进来 / 纸面外的根 / 镜像双胞胎 / i 就是一个矩阵 五场景
changelog.en: Initial release: the quarter turn / through the cubic / roots off the paper / the mirror twin / i is a matrix

title.zh: 条件概率与贝叶斯更新

desc.zh: 条件概率不是新公式，而是「删掉不符合条件的世界，再把剩余概率归一化」：面积模型里 ¬B 淡出、B 放大成新的样本空间；树状图沿路径相乘得到同一个联合分布；再用 10,000 件产品的自然频数走一遍 先验 → 检测 → 只看阳性——灵敏度 95% 的检测，阳性后真有缺陷的概率可能只有 28%。最后在同一张图上分清独立与互斥。
desc.en: Conditioning is not a new formula — it is delete-and-renormalize: in the area model the worlds outside B fade away and B is rescaled into the new sample space; the tree diagram multiplies along paths into the same joint distribution. Then follow 10,000 items in natural frequencies through prior → test → positives-only: a 95%-sensitive test can leave a positive item only 28% likely to be defective. Finally, independent and mutually exclusive are untangled on one picture.

tag.zh: 条件化 · 树状图 · 基准率 · 贝叶斯
tag.en: conditioning · tree diagram · base rate · Bayes

changelog.zh: 首个版本：面积模型 / 树状图 / 贝叶斯反转 / 独立与互斥 四场景（含双语）
changelog.en: Initial release: area model / tree diagram / Bayes inversion / independent vs exclusive — four scenes, bilingual

desc.zh: 指数把相等的输入步长变成相等的倍数变化；对数反过来数「乘了多少次」。四个场景：等步等倍、关于 y = x 的镜像互逆、对数轴上乘法变加法、倍增时间与半衰期。
desc.en: Exponentials turn equal input steps into equal multiples; logarithms count the multiplications back. Four scenes: equal steps & equal ratios, mirror-image inverses across y = x, multiplication becoming addition on a log axis, and doubling time vs half-life.

tag.zh: bˣ · log · 半衰期

changelog.zh: 首个版本：指数增长 / 互为逆运算 / 乘法变加法 / 倍增与半衰 四场景
changelog.en: Initial release: growth, inverses, multiply→add and doubling/half-life scenes

title.zh: 函数的本质 · 映射、变换与逆
title.en: The Essence of Functions · Maps, Transformations & Inverses

desc.zh: 函数不是一条公式，而是输入到输出的唯一对应：正视时映射网塌缩成图像，变换、复合与反函数只是同一映射的不同视角。
desc.en: A function is not a formula but a unique input-to-output correspondence: face-on, the mapping web collapses into the graph, and transformations, composition and inverses are just different views of the same map.

tag.zh: 映射 · 变换 · f⁻¹

changelog.zh: 首个版本：映射 / 图像变换 / 复合 / 反函数 四场景
changelog.en: Initial release: mapping web / transformations / composition / inverse — four scenes

title.zh: 二项式定理 · Pascal 三角形与概率
title.en: The Binomial Theorem · Pascal's Triangle & Probability

desc.zh: 同一个 C(n,k)，四张面孔：展开式的系数、Pascal 三角形的节点、n 步二选一的路径数、二项分布的概率权重——正视三角形看结构，给每步赋上 p，计数就变成了钟形的前身。
desc.en: One C(n,k), four faces: an expansion coefficient, a Pascal's-triangle node, the count of n-step left-right walks, and the binomial probability weight — face the triangle to see the structure, give each step a probability, and counting becomes the bell curve's ancestor.

tag.zh: 系数 · 路径 · 分布

changelog.zh: 首个版本（含双语）：几何展开 / Pascal 三角形 / 路径计数 / 二项分布 四场景
changelog.en: Initial release (bilingual): algebraic expansion / Pascal's triangle / path counting / binomial distribution

desc.zh: 力矩由垂距决定：τ = rF·sin θ = F·d。让两侧力矩曲线重合即是平衡，重力线越过支撑棱边即是倾倒——质心是这一切的支点。
desc.en: A moment is set by the perpendicular distance: τ = rF·sin θ = F·d. Balance is two moment traces coinciding; toppling is the gravity line crossing the base edge — and the centre of mass rules it all.

tag.zh: 力矩 · Στ = 0 · 质心 · 倾倒

changelog.zh: 首个版本：力矩与垂直距离 / 刚体平衡 / 质心 / 倾倒与支撑区域 四场景，含双语
changelog.en: Initial release: four scenes — moment & perpendicular distance, rigid-body equilibrium, centre of mass, toppling & base of support; fully bilingual

desc.zh: 先隔离物体，只画外界施加的力；坐标轴跟着约束面走。看支持力如何响应约束、静摩擦如何跟随需求直到 μR 封顶。
desc.en: Isolate the body and draw only the external forces; let the axes follow the constraint. Watch the normal force respond to the surface and static friction track demand until it caps at μR.
